title: Greenhouse Gases Resulting from Grid-Connected Electricity Demand
The 2021 Child Tax Credit Expansion and Economic Insecurity
Carbon Tariffs
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: We evaluate the economic and environmental consequences of carbon tariffs—taxes on imports of goods based on their carbon content. The analysis uses the simplest possible partial equilibrium framework, with a polluting good traded internationally on world markets, and one small economy whose tariffs do not affect world prices. It relies on graphs of supply and demand rather than equations, hoping to reach readers familiar with basic economics. Despite its simplicity, the framework imparts numerous lessons. (1) Carbon tariffs prevent leakage by shifting the burden of carbon taxes away from producers who might relocate production overseas onto consumers who cannot easily move their consumption abroad. (2) In the absence of a domestic price on carbon, a carbon tariff not only imposes the same costs on domestic consumers as a domestic carbon price but also subsidizes domestic pollution. (3) If one small country imposes a carbon tariff, with or without a domestic carbon tax, the economic incidence of the tariff falls on its consumers. (4) If a newly enacted domestic carbon policy leads to a decline in domestic production offset by a rise in imports, that does not necessarily represent leakage. It could instead describe the cessation of leakage from foreign countries with carbon policies to the domestic economy when it did not have a carbon policy. And (5) if other countries do not appropriately regulate emissions, no single small country can use a combination of carbon taxes and carbon tariffs to fully correct the problem caused by its consumers or producers.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了碳关税（即根据商品所含碳量对进口商品征收的税）的经济和环境后果。分析采用了最简单的局部均衡框架：一种污染性商品在世界市场上进行国际贸易，而一个小型经济体的关税不影响世界价格。本文依靠供给与需求曲线图而非方程进行论述，希望能使熟悉基础经济学的读者易于理解。尽管框架十分简单，却能带来诸多启示。（1）碳关税通过将碳税的负担从可能将生产转移至海外的生产者，转移到难以将消费转移至国外的消费者身上，从而防止碳泄漏。（2）在没有国内碳价的情况下，碳关税不仅会对国内消费者施加与国内碳价相同的成本，还会对国内污染起到补贴作用。（3）如果一个小国征收碳关税，无论是否同时征收国内碳税，关税的经济归宿都将落在其国内消费者身上。（4）如果新颁布的国内碳政策导致国内产量下降，而进口量相应增加，这并不一定意味着存在碳泄漏。它也可能反映的是：当国内尚未实施碳政策时，原本从有碳政策的外国流向国内的泄漏行为就此停止了。（5）如果其他国家没有适当地管控排放，那么任何单一小国都无法仅凭碳税和碳关税的组合，完全纠正由其消费者或生产者所引发的问题。

title: Are Developing Countries Outsourcing Pollution?
Renewable Portfolio Standards
abstract: State-level renewable portfolio standards (RPSs) aim to encourage renewable energy and discourage greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from the electric power sector in the United States. Do they work? Some prominent government agencies and advocacy groups assert that U.S. renewables growth has been largely due to RPSs. That seems unlikely, given that in most regions, renewables exceed RPS requirements. But it is not an easy question to answer, thanks to interstate trading and the possibility that states with abundant renewable resources might set the most ambitious RPS goals. We combine the best features of four recent academic studies, using ordinary least-squares and instrumental variables approaches. In some specifications, RPSs do appear to reduce the use of natural gas to generate electricity and decrease GHG emissions, while boosting the use of wind and solar power. But the effects are small—consistent with the academic findings and in contrast to the public claims and policy goals.
abstract_zh: 美国各州的可再生能源配额制（RPS）旨在鼓励可再生能源发展，并遏制电力部门的温室气体（GHG）排放。它们有效吗？一些知名政府机构和倡导团体断言，美国可再生能源的增长在很大程度上归功于可再生能源配额制。考虑到在大多数地区，可再生能源的发电量已超过配额要求，这一说法似乎不太可能。但由于州际贸易的存在，以及拥有丰富可再生能源资源的州可能设定最为雄心勃勃的配额目标，这一问题并不容易回答。我们综合了四项近期学术研究的最佳特点，采用了普通最小二乘法和工具变量方法。在某些设定下，可再生能源配额制似乎确实减少了天然气发电的使用，降低了温室气体排放，同时促进了风能和太阳能发电。但其效果很小，这与学术研究的结论一致，而与公众的宣称及政策目标形成反差。

title: When Can Benefit-Cost Analyses Ignore Secondary Markets?
Who Values Future Energy Savings? Evidence from American Drivers
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Regulators attest that tightened energy efficiency standards save consumers money. Efficient light bulbs, appliances, and vehicles cost more upfront but reduce energy expenses by more than enough to compensate. We use survey data on American cars and their drivers to examine whether individual drivers have indeed underinvested in fuel economy, given the gas prices they face and the miles they drive. We find that may be true, but only on average. Some drivers could likely have saved money by spending more upfront for efficient cars. But many others could have saved money purchasing less expensive, less fuel-efficient cars. In fact we find little correlation between individual drivers' annual fuel expenditures and their fuel economy choices: a driver's income, sex, age, and education are far more closely associated with their vehicle's fuel economy. We can rule out several explanations for the disconnect. Rich car purchasers do not seem to consider fuel expenses any more than poorer ones, undermining arguments that borrowing constraints prevent low-income consumers from investing in fuel efficiency. And the disconnect between fuel expenses and vehicle choice holds whether we examine anticipated or realized mileage, ruling out mistaken expectations about future driving as an explanation.
abstract_zh: 监管机构断言，收紧的能效标准能为消费者省钱。节能灯泡、家用电器和汽车虽然前期成本更高，但其节省的能源开支足以补偿这些成本。我们利用美国汽车及其驾驶者的调查数据，考察在所面临的油价和行驶里程条件下，个人驾驶者是否确实对燃油经济性投资不足。我们发现，平均而言可能确实如此，但仅限于平均水平。部分驾驶者本可以通过预先多花钱购买高效汽车而节省开支。但也有许多人如果购买价格更低、燃油效率较差的汽车，本可以省钱。事实上，我们发现个人驾驶者的年度燃油支出与其燃油经济性选择之间几乎没有相关性：驾驶者的收入、性别、年龄和教育程度与车辆燃油经济性的关联要紧密得多。我们可以排除几种解释这一脱节现象的理由。富裕的汽车购买者似乎并不比贫穷的购买者更多地考虑燃油开支，这削弱了“借贷约束阻碍低收入消费者投资燃油效率”的论点。而且，无论我们考察的是预期行驶里程还是实际行驶里程，燃油开支与车辆选择之间的脱节都依然存在，这排除了对未来驾驶里程存在错误预期的解释。

title: The Electric Gini: Income Redistribution through Energy Prices
abstract: Efficient electricity pricing involves two-part tariffs: a volumetric price equal to the marginal cost of producing an additional kilowatt hour (kWh) and a fixed fee to cover any remaining fixed costs. In this paper we explore how US electricity regulators depart from this simple two-part tariff to address concerns about income inequality. We first show that in theory, price setters concerned about inequality will charge lower fixed monthly fees and higher per-kWh prices, and increasing block prices to target higher users with even higher prices. Then we use a new dataset of 1,300 utilities across the US to show that these theoretical predictions are borne out in practice. Utilities whose ratepayers have more unequal incomes levy more redistributive tariffs, charging less to low users and more to high users. To quantify these comparisons, we develop a new measure of the redistributive extent of utility tariffs that we call the "electric Gini."Utilities with higher electric Ginis (more redistributive tariffs) shift costs from households that use relatively little electricity to households that use more. But because electricity use is only loosely correlated with income, that redistribution does not meaningfully shift costs from households with low incomes to those with high incomes.
abstract_zh: 有效率的电价采用两部制：按用电量计价的电价等于生产额外一千瓦时（kWh）电力的边际成本，同时通过固定费用来弥补剩余的固定成本。本文探讨了美国电力监管机构如何偏离这种简单的两部制电价，以应对收入不平等问题。我们首先证明，从理论上看，关注不平等的定价者会收取较低的固定月费和较高的每千瓦时电价，并采用递增阶梯电价，对高用电户收取更高的价格。随后，我们利用一个包含美国1300家公用事业公司的新数据集，表明这些理论预测在实践中得到了验证。用户收入差距较大的公用事业公司会实施更具再分配性质的电价，对低用电户收取较少，对高用电户收取较多。为量化这些比较，我们提出了一个衡量公用事业电价再分配程度的新指标，我们称之为“电力基尼系数”（“electric Gini”）。电力基尼系数较高的公用事业公司（即电价再分配程度更高的公司）会将成本从用电量相对较少的家庭转移到用电量较多的家庭。但由于用电量与收入的相关性很弱，这种再分配并不会显著地将成本从低收入家庭转移到高收入家庭。

title: Energy Intensity: Deindustrialization, Composition, Prices, and Policies in U.S. States
The Role of Retrospective Analysis in an Era of Deregulation: Lessons from the US Mercury and Air Toxics Standards

title: America's Regressive Wealth Tax: State and Local Property Taxes
Co-Benefits and Regulatory Impact Analysis: Theory and Evidence from Federal Air Quality Regulations
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper considers the treatment of co-benefits in benefit-cost analysis of federal air quality regulations. Using a comprehensive data set on all major Clean Air Act rules issued by the Environmental Protection Agency over the period 1997-2019, we show that (1) co-benefits make up a significant share of the monetized benefits; (2) among the categories of co-benefits, those associated with reductions in fine particulate matter are the most significant; and (3) co-benefits have been pivotal to the quantified net benefit calculation in exactly half of cases. Motivated by these trends, we develop a simple conceptual framework that illustrates a critical point: co-benefits are simply a semantic category of benefits that should be included in benefit-cost analyses. We also address common concerns about whether the inclusion of co-benefits is problematic because of alternative regulatory approaches that may be more cost-effective and the possibility for double counting.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨联邦空气质量法规效益—成本分析中对协同效益的处理。利用1997—2019年间美国环境保护署（EPA）发布的所有主要《清洁空气法》规则的综合数据集，我们表明：（1）协同效益在货币化效益中占据相当大的份额；（2）在各类协同效益中，与细颗粒物（PM2.5）减排相关的效益最为重要；（3）在恰好一半的情形中，协同效益对量化的净效益计算起到了关键作用。基于这些趋势，我们构建了一个简单的概念框架，阐明了一个关键观点：协同效益本质上只是效益的一种语义类别，理应纳入效益—成本分析。我们还讨论了一些常见的担忧，包括纳入协同效益是否会因存在成本效益更高的替代监管方式而出现问题，以及是否存在重复计算的可能性。

title: Energy Efficiency Standards Are More Regressive Than Energy Taxes: Theory and Evidence
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Economists promote energy taxes as cost-effective. But policymakers raise concerns about their regressivity, or disproportional burden on poorer families, preferring to set energy efficiency standards instead.I first show that in theory, regulations targeting energy efficiency are more regressive than energy taxes, not less.I then provide an example in the context of automotive fuel consumption in the United States: taxing gas would be less regressive than regulating the fuel economy of cars if the two policies are compared on a revenue-equivalent basis.
abstract_zh: 经济学家提倡能源税，认为其具有成本效益。但政策制定者担心能源税具有累退性，即对较贫穷家庭的负担成比例地更重，因此更倾向于设定能效标准。我首先从理论上证明，针对能源效率的监管比能源税更具累退性，而非更少。随后，我以美国汽车燃油消耗为例：如果在收入等价的基础上比较这两种政策，对汽油征税的累退性将低于对汽车燃油经济性进行监管。

title: Environmental Engel Curves: Indirect Emissions of Common Air Pollutants
abstract: Environmental Engel curves (EECs) describe households’ incomes and the pollution necessary to produce the goods and services they consume. We calculate 29 annual EECs from 1984 to 2012 for point-source air pollutants in the United States, revealing three clear results: EECs slope upward, have income elasticities less than 1, and shift down over time. Even without changes to production techniques, pollution would have declined despite growing incomes. This improvement can be attributed about equally to two trends: household income growth represented by movement along inelastic EECs and economy-wide changes represented by downward shifts in EECs over time.
abstract_zh: 环境恩格尔曲线（EEC）描述了家庭收入与其所消费商品和服务的生产所需污染之间的关系。我们计算了1984至2012年美国29种常见大气污染物的年度环境恩格尔曲线，揭示了三个清晰的结论：环境恩格尔曲线向上倾斜，收入弹性小于1，并且随时间推移整体下移。即使生产技术不发生变化，尽管收入增长，污染物排放量仍会下降。这一改善大致可归因于两种趋势的作用：以缺乏弹性的环境恩格尔曲线上的移动所代表的家庭收入增长，以及以曲线随时间向下移动所代表的全经济范围的变化，二者的贡献大致相当。

title: Mercury and Air Toxics Standards: Co-Benefits and the Courts in U.S. Cost-Benefit Analysis
Misreporting Trade: Tariff Evasion, Corruption, and Auditing Standards
Automobile Fuel Economy and Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards
abstract: In March 2017, EPA Administrator Scott Pruitt reopened an evaluation of the automotive fuel economy and greenhouse gas emissions standards that the EPA had finalized in January. This case provides a history of the rules, along with assessments of their costs and benefits. It addresses numerous debates, including the environmental benefits of the rules, the role of electric vehicles, whether the standards should be less strict for larger cars, and tradeoffs between fuel economy and safety.
abstract_zh: 2017年3月，美国环境保护署（EPA）署长斯科特·普鲁伊特（Scott Pruitt）重新启动了对汽车燃油经济性和温室气体排放标准的评估，而该标准是EPA于当年1月最终确定的。本案例回顾了这些规则的历史，并对其成本与收益进行了评估。本案例涉及众多争议，包括这些规则的环境效益、电动汽车的作用、标准是否应对大型汽车适当放宽，以及燃油经济性与安全性之间的权衡。

title: Environmental Protectionism: The Case of CAFE
How Much Energy Do Building Energy Codes Save? Evidence from California Houses
abstract: Regulations governing the energy efficiency of new buildings have become a cornerstone of US environmental policy. California enacted the first such codes in 1978 and has tightened them every few years since. I evaluate the resulting energy savings three ways: comparing energy used by houses constructed under different standards, controlling for building and occupant characteristics; examining how energy use varies with outdoor temperatures; and comparing energy used by houses of different vintages in California to that same difference in other states. All three approaches yield estimated energy savings significantly short of those projected when the regulations were enacted. (JEL Q48, Q51, Q52)
abstract_zh: 关于新建筑能源效率的法规已成为美国环境政策的基石。加利福尼亚州于1978年率先颁布了此类规范，此后每隔几年便对其进行收紧。我从三个角度评估了由此产生的节能效果：在控制建筑和住户特征的前提下，比较不同标准下建造的住宅的能源使用情况；考察能源使用量随室外温度的变化；以及将加利福尼亚州不同年代建造的住宅的能源使用差异，与其他州相同年代差异进行对比。这三种方法得出的节能估计值均显著低于法规出台时所预测的水平。（JEL Q48, Q51, Q52）

title: Measuring Environmental Regulatory Stringency
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: A Direct Estimate of the Technique Effect: Changes in the Pollution Intensity of US Manufacturing 1990-2008
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: From 1990 to 2008, the real value of US manufacturing output grew by one-third while the pollution emitted from US factories fell by two-thirds. What accounts for this cleanup? Prior studies have documented that a relatively small share can be explained by changes in the composition of US manufacturing - a shift towards producing relatively more goods whose production processes involve less pollution. Those studies attribute the unexplained majority to "technique", a mix of input substitution, process changes, and end-of-pipe controls. But because that technique effect is a residual left over after other explanations, any errors or interactions in the original calculation could inflate the estimated technique. In this paper I provide the first direct estimate of the technique effect. I combine the National Emissions Inventories with the NBER-CES Manufacturing Industry Database for each of over 400 manufacturing industries. I aggregate across industries using analogs to the Laspeyres and Paasche price indexes for each of six major air pollutants. The calculations using this direct estimation of the technique effect support the research findings using indirect measures. From 1990 to 2008, production technique changes account for more than 90 percent of the overall cleanup of US manufacturing.
abstract_zh: 1990至2008年间，美国制造业的实际产值增长了三分之一，而美国工厂排放的污染物却减少了三分之二。这种污染治理是如何实现的？以往研究发现，只有相对较小的一部分可以由美国制造业结构的变化加以解释，即生产过程污染较少的商品在产出中的比重上升。这些研究将其余未被解释的大部分归因于“技术效应”，它包括投入替代、工艺改进和末端治理等综合因素。但由于技术效应是在扣除其他解释之后的剩余项，原始计算中的任何误差或交互作用都可能夸大所估计的技术效应。在本文中，我首次对技术效应进行了直接估计。我将国家排放清单（National Emissions Inventories）与NBER-CES制造业产业数据库相结合，覆盖400多个制造业行业。我采用类似拉氏（Laspeyres）和帕氏（Paasche）价格指数的方法，针对六种主要大气污染物，对各行业进行加总。基于这种对技术效应的直接估计所得出的计算结果，支持了采用间接度量方法得出的研究发现。1990至2008年间，生产技术的变化解释了美国制造业整体污染减少的90%以上。

title: California Energy Efficiency: Lessons for the Rest of the World, or Not?
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: Starting in the 1970sCalifornia's residential electricity consumption per capita stopped increasing, while other states' electricity use continued to grow steadily. Similar patterns can be seen in non-electric energy, industry, and transportation. What accounts for California's apparent energy savings? Some credit the strict energy efficiency standards for buildings and appliances enacted by California in the mid-1970s.They argue that other states and countries could replicate California's gains, and that California should build on its own success by tightening those standards further. Skeptics might point to three long-run trends that differentiate California's electricity demand from other states: (1) shifting of the U.S. population towards warmer climates of the South and West; (2) relatively small income elasticity of energy demand in California's temperate climate; and (3) evolving differences between the demographics of households in California and other states. Together, these trends account for around 90 percent of California's apparent residential electricity savings, thus providing no lessons for other states or countries considering adopting or tightening their energy efficiency standards.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪70年代起，加利福尼亚州的人均居民用电量停止增长，而其他州的用电量则持续稳步上升。非电力能源、工业和交通领域也呈现出类似的格局。是什么导致了加利福尼亚州这种明显的节能效果？一些人将其归功于该州在1970年代中期颁布的严格建筑和家用电器能效标准。他们认为，其他州和国家可以复制加利福尼亚州的成果，而加利福尼亚州也应当在自身成功的基础上，进一步收紧这些标准。持怀疑态度的人则可能指出，有三种长期趋势使加利福尼亚州的电力需求有别于其他州：（1）美国人口向南部和西部较温暖气候地区的迁移；（2）加利福尼亚州温和气候下能源需求的收入弹性相对较小；（3）加州与其他州家庭人口结构的差异不断演变。这些趋势共同解释了加利福尼亚州表面上居民用电节约量的约90%，因此对于考虑采用或收紧能效标准的其他州或国家而言，并不能提供任何借鉴。

title: Waste of Effort? International Environmental Agreements
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Many of the world's environmental problems cross international borders, and to address those problems approximately 1,000 different International Environmental Agreements (IEAs) are in operation today. Most evidence, however suggests that those IEAs are ineffectual, merely ratifying business-as-usual outcomes and doing little to improve the environment. But much of that empirical analysis faces two obstacles: (1) limited data from before the IEAs were enacted and thus an inability to make before-andafter comparisons; and (2) difficulty estimating the counterfactual outcomes -what would have happened absent the agreements. In this paper we test the effectiveness of one particular IEA -the Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal. In this special case we have data on international waste shipments from both before and after countries ratify the agreement, along with a unique approach to identifying the treaty's effect using annual bilateral waste shipments among countries before and after one of the trading partners signs the agreement. Despite the strengths of this approach, we find almost no evidence that the Convention has resulted in less waste being shipped among countries.
abstract_zh: 世界上许多环境问题跨越国界，为应对这些问题，目前约有1000项不同的国际环境协定（IEAs）正在实施。然而，大多数证据表明，这些协定效果有限，只是确认了照常发展的结果，对改善环境几乎没有作用。但是，这类实证分析大多面临两个障碍：（1）协定签署前的数据有限，因而无法进行前后对比；（2）难以估计反事实结果，即如果没有这些协定，结果会如何。在本文中，我们检验了一项特定国际环境协定的有效性，即《控制危险废物越境转移及其处置的巴塞尔公约》（Basel Convention）。在这一特殊案例中，我们拥有该公约在各国批准前后的国际废物运输数据，并采用了一种独特的方法，即利用一个贸易伙伴签署该协定前后各国之间的年度双边废物运输数据来识别该公约的效果。尽管这一方法具有诸多优点，我们却几乎没有发现证据表明，该公约减少了各国之间的废物运输量。

title: Happiness, Behavioral Economics, and Public Policy
Valuing Public Goods Using Happiness Data: The Case of Air Quality
abstract: This paper describes and implements a method for estimating the average marginal value of a time-varying local public good: air quality. It uses the General Social Survey (GSS), which asks thousands of people in various U.S. locations how happy they are, along with other demographic and attitude questions. These data are matched with the Environmental Protection Agency's Air Quality System (AQS) to find the level of pollution in those locations on the dates the survey questions were asked. People with higher incomes in any given year and location report higher levels of happiness, and people interviewed on days when air pollution was worse than the local seasonal average report lower levels of happiness. Combining these two concepts, I derive the average marginal rate of substitution between income and air quality -a compensating variation for air pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文描述并实施了一种方法，用于估计一种随时间变化的地方公共物品——空气质量——的平均边际价值。该方法使用综合社会调查（GSS）数据，该调查询问美国各地数千人的幸福感，同时收集其他人口统计学及态度类问题。这些数据与美国环境保护署的空气质量系统（AQS）数据相匹配，以获取受访者在接受调查当日所在地的污染水平。在任一年份和地点，收入较高的人报告的幸福感更高；而在空气污染程度高于当地季节性平均水平的日子接受访问的人，报告的幸福感则更低。综合这两个概念，我推导出了收入与空气质量之间的平均边际替代率，即空气污染的补偿变化。

title: Offshoring pollution: Is the U.S. increasingly importing polluting goods?
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The question posed by the title of this article has been at the heart of debates about pollution havens, industrial flight to developing countries, and now carbon “leakage.” Is the United States increasingly importing goods whose production generates relatively more pollution, rather than manufacturing those goods domestically? The consensus seems to be “yes,” at least judging by the many public policies designed to counteract this offshoring of pollution. The evidence, however, is mixed, at least in part because empirical research has focused on a slightly different set of questions. After reviewing this research, I present a simple methodology for answering the specific question asked in the title. Using the World Bank's 1987 inventory of industry-specific U.S. air pollution emissions intensities, Bureau of Economic Analysis input–output tables, and data on U.S. imports, I show that from 1972 to 2001 the composition of U.S. imports shifted toward relatively clean goods, rather than polluting goods. Perhaps more surprising, this “green” shift of U.S. imports is even larger than the corresponding green shift of U.S. domestic manufacturing. Based on this analysis, the article concludes that over the past thirty years, the United States does not appear to have been offshoring pollution by importing polluting goods.
abstract_zh: 本文标题所提出的问题，一直是关于污染避难所、产业向发展中国家转移，以及如今的碳“泄漏”等争论的核心。美国是否正越来越多地进口生产过程污染更为严重的商品，而非在国内生产这些商品？从众多旨在抵消这种污染转移的公共政策来看，共识似乎是“是”。然而，证据却喜忧参半，部分原因在于实证研究关注的问题与此略有不同。在回顾这些研究之后，我提出了一种简单的方法，用于回答标题所提出的具体问题。利用世界银行1987年编制的分行业美国大气污染排放强度清单、经济分析局（BEA）的投入产出表以及美国进口数据，我发现，1972至2001年间，美国进口的构成向相对清洁的商品转移，而非污染性商品。更令人惊讶的是，这种进口的“绿色”转移甚至比同期美国国内制造业相应的“绿色”转移还要大。基于这一分析，本文得出结论：在过去三十年中，美国似乎并未通过进口污染性商品而将污染转移到海外。

title: Pollution and International Trade in Services
venue: International Environmental Agreements: Politics, Law and Economics
abstract: Two central topics in recent rounds of international trade negotiations have been environmental concerns, and services trade. While each is undoubtedly important, they are unrelated. In this paper I show that the services-environment link is small, for two reasons. First, services account for only a small fraction of overall pollution. For none of five major air pollutants does the service sector account for even four percent of total emissions; for three of the five services account for less than one percent. Second, those service industries that do pollute are the least likely to be traded internationally. Those services for which the U.S. collects and publishes international trade data -presumably those services that are traded internationally -are less polluting than services for which trade data do not existpresumably because the services are not traded. Even if we limit attention to the services that are traded across borders, the service industries most intensively traded are the ones that pollute the least. The bottom line is simple. International services trade bears little relation to the environment, because services in general contribute relatively little to overall pollution, and those industries that are traded internationally are among the least polluting.
abstract_zh: 近期国际贸易谈判的两个核心议题是环境问题与服务贸易。虽然二者无疑都很重要，但它们之间并无关联。在本文中，我证明服务业与环境之间的联系很小，原因有二。第一，服务业只占总污染的一小部分。就五种主要大气污染物而言，服务业在任何一种污染物的总排放中所占比重都不超过4%；其中三种污染物的排放中，服务业的占比不足1%。第二，那些确实造成污染的服务行业，恰恰是最不可能进行国际贸易的行业。美国收集并公布国际贸易数据的服务业——推测这些服务是可以跨境交易的——其污染程度低于没有贸易数据的服务业，后者推测是因为这些服务无法进行贸易。即使我们只关注可跨境交易的服务，贸易最为密集的服务行业也恰恰是污染最少的行业。结论很简单：国际服务贸易与环境几乎没有关系，因为服务业整体对总污染的贡献相对较小，而那些进行国际贸易的行业本身也属于污染最少的行业之列。

title: Technology, International Trade, and Pollution from U.S. Manufacturing
abstract: Total pollution emitted by U.S. manufacturers declined over the past 30 years, even though manufacturing output increased. This improvement must result from one of two trends: (1) changes in production or abatement processes ("technology"); or (2) changes in the mix of goods manufactured in the United States, which itself may result from increased net imports of pollution-intensive goods ("international trade"). In this paper, I first show that most of the decline in pollution from U.S. manufacturing has been the result of changing technology instead of changes in the mix of goods produced, although the pace of that technology change has slowed over time. Second, I present evidence that increases in net imports of pollution-intensive goods are too small to explain more than about half of the pollution reductions from the changing mix of goods produced in the United States. Together, these two findings demonstrate that shifting polluting industries overseas has played at most a minor role in the cleanup of the U.S. manufacturing sector.
abstract_zh: 过去30年间，尽管制造业产出有所增加，但美国制造商的污染物排放总量却有所下降。这一改善必定源于以下两种趋势之一：（1）生产或治污工艺的变化（“技术”）；或（2）美国国内生产的商品结构的变化，而这种变化本身可能源于污染密集型商品净进口的增加（“国际贸易”）。在本文中，我首先证明，美国制造业污染的大部分下降是技术变化的结果，而非所生产商品结构变化的结果，尽管这种技术变化的速度随时间推移有所放缓。其次，我提供了证据表明，污染密集型商品净进口的增加，其规模太小，不足以解释商品结构变化所带来的污染减少中超过一半的部分。综合这两项发现，表明将污染产业转移到海外对美国制造业的污染治理只起到了很小的作用。

title: Unmasking the Pollution Haven Effect
abstract: This paper uses both theory and empirical work to examine the effect of environmental regulations on trade flows. We develop a simple economic model to demonstrate how unobserved heterogeneity, endogeneity and aggregation issues bias measurements of the relationship between regulatory costs and trade. We apply an estimating equation derived from the model to data on U.S. regulations and net trade flows among the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, for 130 manufacturing industries from 1977 to 1986.Our results indicate that industries whose abatement costs increased most experienced the largest increases in net imports. For the 20 industries hardest hit by regulation, the change in net imports we ascribe to the increase in regulatory costs amounts to more than half of the total increase in trade volume over the period.
abstract_zh: 本文同时运用理论与实证方法，考察环境管制对贸易流动的影响。我们构建了一个简单的经济模型，以说明不可观测的异质性、内生性和加总问题如何使监管成本与贸易之间关系的度量产生偏误。我们将由该模型推导出的估计方程应用于美国管制数据，以及美国、加拿大和墨西哥之间的净贸易流量数据，涵盖1977至1986年间130个制造业行业。结果表明，减排成本增幅最大的行业，其净进口增幅也最大。对于受管制冲击最大的20个行业，我们归因于监管成本增加而产生的净进口变化，超过了同期贸易总量增长的一半以上。

title: Budget Rules and State Business Cycles: A Comment
Employee Cost-sharing and the Welfare Effects of Flexible Spending Accounts
Labor Supply Effects of the Earned Income Tax Credit: Evidence from Wisconsin's Supplemental Benefit for Families with Three Children
Footloose and Pollution-Free
abstract: In numerous studies, economists have found little empirical evidence that environmental regulations affect trade flows. In this paper, we propose and test several common explanations for why the effect of environmental regulations on trade may be difficult to detect. We demonstrate that while most trade occurs among industrialized economies, environmental regulations have stronger effects on trade between industrialized and developing economies. We find that for most industries, pollution abatement costs are a small component of total costs, and are unrelated to trade flows. In addition, we show that those industries with the largest pollution abatement costs also happen to be the least geographically mobile, or "footloose."After accounting for these distinctions, we measure a significant effect of pollution abatement costs on imports from developing countries, and in pollution-intensive, footloose industries.
abstract_zh: 在大量研究中，经济学家发现几乎没有实证证据表明环境管制会影响贸易流动。在本文中，我们提出并检验了几种常见解释，以说明为什么环境管制对贸易的影响可能难以被检测到。我们证明，尽管大多数贸易发生在工业化经济体之间，但环境管制对工业化经济体与发展中经济体之间的贸易影响更为显著。我们发现，对于大多数行业而言，污染治理成本只占总成本的一小部分，且与贸易流量无关。此外，我们还表明，污染治理成本最高的行业恰恰也是地理流动性最差、即所谓“易于迁移”程度最低的行业。在考虑了这些区别之后，我们发现污染治理成本对来自发展中国家的进口，以及对污染密集且易于迁移的行业，都具有显著影响。

title: Energy Use by Apartment Tenants When Landlords Pay for Utilities
Examining the Evidence on Environmental Regulations and Industry Location
venue: Journal of the Environment and Development
abstract: This article offers a review and critique of the large literature on the pollution havens hypothesis. This hypothesis refers to the notion that certain jurisdictions can become pollution havens as dirty industries relocate or expand in response to differences in regulatory stringency. The early literature, based on cross-sectional analyses, typically concludes that environmental regulations have an insignificant effect on firm location decisions. However, recent studies that use panel data to control for unobserved heterogeneity, or instruments to control for endogeneity, find statistically significant pollution haven effects of reasonable magnitude. Furthermore, this distinction appears regardless of whether the studies look across countries, states, counties, or industries, or whether they examine plant locations, investment, or international trade patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文对关于污染避难所假说的大量文献进行了综述与批判。该假说指的是，随着污染行业因管制严格程度的差异而迁移或扩张，某些司法辖区可能会成为污染避难所。早期基于截面分析的文献通常认为，环境管制对企业选址决策的影响并不显著。然而，近期利用面板数据控制不可观测异质性、或利用工具变量控制内生性的研究，则发现了统计上显著、且幅度合理的污染避难所效应。此外，无论研究考察的是国家、州、县还是行业之间的差异，无论研究关注的是工厂选址、投资还是国际贸易格局，这一区别都是存在的。

title: Trade Liberalization and Pollution Havens
venue: Advances in Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: U.S. Presidential Executive Order 13141 commits the United States to a "careful assessment and consideration of the environmental impacts of trade agreements."The most direct mechanism through which trade liberalization would affect environmental quality in the U.S. is through changes in the composition of industries. Freer trade means greater specialization, increasing the concentration of polluting industries in some countries and decreasing it in others. Indeed, in this paper we predict a substantial reduction in U.S. pollution from 1978-94 due entirely to a shift in the composition of U.S. manufacturing toward cleaner industries. We then use annual industry-level data on imports to the U.S. to examine whether this compositional shift can be traced to the significant trade liberalization that occurred over the same time period; we conclude that no such connection exists. First, we find that a shift toward cleaner industries, similar to that observed in U.S. manufacturing, has also occurred among U.S. imports. Second, we find no evidence that pollution-intensive industries have been disproportionately affected by the tariff changes over that time period.
abstract_zh: 美国总统第13141号行政令承诺，美国将对贸易协定的环境影响进行“审慎评估与考量”。环境管制的变化影响环境质量最直接的渠道，是产业构成的变化。更自由的贸易意味着更大程度的专业化分工，使污染性产业在一些国家集中度上升，而在另一些国家则下降。事实上，在本文中，我们预测1978至1994年间美国污染物排放将大幅减少，而这完全归因于美国制造业构成向更清洁的产业转变。随后，我们利用美国进口的年度行业层面数据，检验这一构成转变是否可以追溯到同一时期发生的大幅贸易自由化；我们的结论是，两者之间并不存在这种联系。首先，我们发现美国进口中也出现了与美国制造业类似的、向清洁产业转变的趋势。其次，我们没有发现证据表明，在此期间关税变化对污染密集型行业产生了不成比例的影响。

title: Willingness to Pay for the Environment: Testable Empirical Implications of the Growth and Environment Literature
venue: Contributions to Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: Several different theoretical models of economic growth and environmental quality each generate inverse-U-shaped pollution-income paths, or "environmental Kuznets curves." They rely on different assumptions to generate the reversal of pollution trends, with correspondingly different policy implications. While the empirical implications for pollution are indistinguishable (by design), the models have distinct implications for the pattern of people's marginal willingness to pay (MWTP) for environmental improvements as a function of income. In this paper we demonstrate those different implications theoretically, and test for them empirically using data from the World Value Survey (WVS). We find strong relationships between MWTP and individual characteristics, such as age, income, and education, but little evidence that MWTP varies systematically with economic growth.
abstract_zh: 关于经济增长与环境质量的若干不同理论模型，均会生成呈倒U形的污染-收入路径，即所谓的“环境库兹涅茨曲线”。这些模型依赖不同的假设来产生污染趋势的逆转，因而具有相应不同的政策含义。尽管它们对污染的经验含义（按设计而言）难以区分，但这些模型对于人们为改善环境的边际支付意愿（MWTP）随收入变化的模式有着不同的含义。在本文中，我们从理论上论证了这些不同的含义，并利用世界价值观调查（WVS）数据进行了实证检验。我们发现，边际支付意愿与年龄、收入和教育等个体特征之间存在较强的关系，但几乎没有证据表明边际支付意愿会随经济增长而系统性地变化。

title: Environmental Regulatory Competition: A Status Report and Some New Evidence
abstract: Concerns about devolving environmental regulatory powers to lower levels of government permeate debates in the U.S. and Europe about the appropriate level of regulatory authority. In theory, given a long list of conditions, regulatory competition by local governments can be efficient in the same way that tax competition can be efficient: local welfare-maximizing governments set the same standards or taxes as would an omniscient welfare-maximizing central government. In practice, however, these conditions are improbable, especially in the case of environmental regulations, and local competition is potentially inefficient. In the past two years, evidence has begun to emerge regarding the empirical importance of these inefficiencies. In this paper, I describe this nascent literature, drawing parallels to the tax competition literature, suggest some avenues for empirical research, and present some new results.
abstract_zh: 在美国和欧洲关于适宜的监管权威层级的辩论中，将环境监管权力下放至较低级别政府的担忧十分普遍。从理论上讲，在一系列苛刻条件下，地方政府之间的监管竞争可以像税收竞争那样具有效率：以福利最大化为目标的地方政府所设定的标准或税率，与一个无所不知、以福利最大化为目标的中央政府所设定的标准或税率相同。然而在实践中，这些条件很难满足，尤其是在环境监管领域，地方竞争可能是低效率的。在过去两年中，关于这些低效率的实证重要性的证据开始出现。在本文中，我梳理了这一新兴文献，与税收竞争文献进行了类比，提出了若干实证研究方向，并呈现了一些新的结果。

title: Pollution Abatement Costs and FDI Inflows to U.S. States
Reexamining the Empirical Evidence for an Environmental Kuznets Curve
abstract: This paper uses an updated and revised panel data set on ambient air pollution in cities worldwide to examine the robustness of the evidence for the existence of an inverted U-shaped relationship between national income and pollution. We test the sensitivity of the pollution-income relationship to functional forms, to additional covariates, and to changes in the nations, cities, and years sampled. We find that the results are highly sensitive to these changes. We conclude that there is little empirical support for an inverted-U-shaped relationship between several important air pollutants and national income in these data.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一套更新和修订后的全球城市环境空气污染面板数据，检验了关于国民收入与污染之间存在倒U形关系这一证据的稳健性。我们检验了污染-收入关系对函数形式、附加协变量，以及所选取国家、城市和年份变化的敏感性。我们发现，结果对上述变化高度敏感。我们的结论是，在这些数据中，几种重要大气污染物与国民收入之间存在倒U形关系的实证支持很少。

title: The Simple Analytics of the Environmental Kuznets Curve
abstract: Evidence suggests that some pollutants follow an inverse-U-shaped pattern relative to countries' incomes. This relationship has been called the "environmental Kuznets curve." This paper lays out a simple and straight-forward static model of the microfoundations of the pollution-income relationship. We sho that the environmental Kuznets curve can be derived directly from the technological link between consumption of a desired good and abatement of its undesirable byproduct. The inverse-U shape does not depend on the dynamics of growth, political institutions, or even externalities, and can be consistent with a decentralized economy as well as a Pareto efficient policy.
abstract_zh: 有证据表明，某些污染物相对于各国收入呈现倒U形模式。这一关系被称为“环境库兹涅茨曲线”。本文提出了一个简单直接的静态模型，用以刻画污染-收入关系的微观基础。我们证明，环境库兹涅茨曲线可以直接从理想商品消费与其有害副产品治理之间的技术联系中推导出来。这一倒U形并不依赖于增长动态、政治制度甚至外部性，并且既可以与分散化经济相一致，也可以与帕累托有效的政策相一致。

title: The Missing Pollution Haven Effect: Examining Some Common Explanations
Grandfather Regulations, New Source Bias, and State Air Toxics Regulations
NIMBY Taxes Matter: The Case of State Hazardous Waste Disposal Taxes
Rainy Day Funds and State Government Savings
State Taxes and Interstate Hazardous Waste Shipments
Balanced Budgets and Business Cycles: Evidence from the States
Factoring the Environmental Kuznets Curve: Evidence from Automotive Lead Emissions
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This article describes the relationship between automotive lead emissions and national income for 48 countries over 20 years. It draws three principal conclusions. First, lead emissions can be shown to follow an inverse- U or an “environmental Kuznets curve” with respect to income. Second, the peak of this curve is sensitive to both the functional form estimated and the time period considered. Third, automotive lead pollution is the product of two separate factors, lead per gallon of gasoline (pollution intensity) and gasoline consumption (polluting activity), and the declining portion of the curve depends critically on reducing gasoline lead content, not gasoline use.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了48个国家在20年间汽车含铅排放与国民收入之间的关系。文章得出三个主要结论。第一，含铅排放可以被证明相对于收入呈倒U形，即“环境库兹涅茨曲线”。第二，该曲线的峰值对所估计的函数形式和所考察的时间段都很敏感。第三，汽车含铅污染是两个独立因素的乘积：每加仑汽油的含铅量（污染强度）和汽油消费量（污染活动）；而曲线下降段则关键取决于降低汽油的含铅量，而非减少汽油使用量。

title: Medicaid Managed Care and Infant Health
A Note on Environmental Federalism: Interpreting Some Contradictory Results
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Why Oppose TDRs?: Transferable Development Rights Can Increase Overall Development
Environmental Regulations and Manufacturers' Location Choices: Evidence from the Census of Manufactures
Efficient Environmental Regulation: Case Studies of Urban Air Pollution in Los Angeles, Mexico City, Cubatao, and Ankara
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper

title: Reexamining Teacher Preferences and Compensating Wages
